verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants search errors and triage issues ([sentry-docs-8], [sentry-probe-3], [sentry-docs-5], [sentry-docs-38]). Its REST API documents listing a project's issues and bulk-mutating them ([sentry-docs-23]), and issue states support triage workflows ([sentry-docs-20]). That covers the pull-and-triage half well, but the evidence never shows an agent filing bugs into an external tracker such as Jira or GitHub Issues. The coding-agent integration only covers fixes and pull requests ([sentry-docs-41]). Missing for 10: documented tracker integration or MCP tool for filing issues, explicit confirmation that stack traces are returned via MCP/API, a ranking for 'top' issues, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
